title: Nasruddin Tale 173: The Two Camels
summary: A traveler complained of carrying a small leather pouch....
full_text:
A traveler complained of carrying a small leather pouch.

Nasruddin pointed to a passing caravan of laden camels: "Look at those noble beasts! They carry four hundredweight across burning salt flats without uttering a single complaint, while you wail over a bag of roasted chickpeas!"
moral: The camel carries its hump in silence; do not magnify your petty burdens.
